items.question: What is Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) according to the PDF?
options: Programming methodology that defines objects rather than functions and logic
Programming methodology that defines functions and logic rather than objects
A way to design databases using tables and rows
A markup language for structuring web pages
items.explanation: The PDF defines OOP as a programming methodology that defines objects rather than functions and logic.

items.question: An object is an instance of a _____.
items.explanation: The PDF states that an object is an instance of a class.

items.question: A class is a blueprint for defining an object.
items.explanation: The PDF defines a class as a blueprint for defining an object.

items.question: What keyword is used to inherit from a class?
items.explanation: The PDF lists inheritance and states that it uses extends.

items.question: What is a method?
options: Behavior defined by a piece of Java class, grouping statements to perform an operation
A variable declared outside a method
An address of an object's memory location
A collection of related classes and interfaces
items.explanation: The PDF defines a method as behavior defined by a piece of Java class and as a collection of statements grouped together to perform an operation.

items.question: A _____ is a list of variables in a method declaration.
items.explanation: The PDF defines a parameter as the list of variables in a method declaration.

items.question: An argument is the actual value that is passed.
items.explanation: The PDF defines an argument as the actual value that is passed.

items.question: What term describes variables declared outside the method?
items.explanation: The PDF states that instance variables are variables declared outside the method.

items.question: What is the mechanism for restricting access to components?
options: Information hiding
Encapsulation
Inheritance
Polymorphism
items.explanation: The PDF defines information hiding as a mechanism for restricting access.

items.question: A(n) _____ returns data from a private instance variable.
items.explanation: The PDF defines an accessor as returning data from a private instance variable.

items.question: A mutator changes the data stored in one or more private instance variables.
items.explanation: The PDF defines a mutator as changing the data stored in one or more private instance variables.

items.question: What term describes combining data and actions into a single item?
items.explanation: The PDF defines encapsulation as combining data and actions into a single item.

items.question: What does a UML Class Diagram display?
options: Class name, variables, and methods
Object addresses, method calls, and packages
Only instance variables
Only public methods
items.explanation: The PDF states that a UML Class Diagram describes the structure of a class by displaying the class name, variables, and methods.

items.question: Class types are _____ types, so instead of == use equals().
items.explanation: The PDF states that class types are reference types and that instead of == you should use equals().

items.question: A constructor has a return type.
items.explanation: The PDF states that a constructor does not have a return type.

items.question: What keyword is used to create and initialize an object?
items.explanation: The PDF states that a constructor uses the new keyword to create and initialize an object.

items.question: Which statement about static variables is correct?
options: They are shared by all objects of its class
They are unique to each object
They are always constants
They cannot be public or private
items.explanation: The PDF states that static variables are shared by all objects of its class.

items.question: A static method can be invoked without using any _____.
items.explanation: The PDF defines a static method as a method that can be invoked without using any objects.

items.question: A static method can reference an instance variable of the class.
items.explanation: The PDF states that a static method cannot reference an instance variable of the class.

items.question: Which predefined Math class method returns the absolute value of a number?
options: Math.abs()
Math.pow()
Math.max()
Math.sqrt()
items.explanation: The PDF lists absolute value as Math.abs().

items.question: Overloading occurs when multiple methods have the same name within the same class but differ in what?
options: The method definitions, such as the number and types of parameters
The class name only
The package name only
The access modifier only
items.explanation: The PDF states that overloading is when multiple methods have the same name within the same class, done by having different method definitions and signatures.

items.question: A method's signature consists of its name and the number and types of its _____.
items.explanation: The PDF defines a signature as the method name and the number and types of its parameters.

items.question: A derived class inherits constructors from the base class.
items.explanation: The PDF states that a subclass does not inherit any constructors from the base class.

items.question: What is another name for a derived class?
items.explanation: The PDF states that a derived class is also called a subclass.

items.question: What is method overriding?
options: A derived class defines a method with the same name, same number and types of parameters, and same return type as a method in the base class
Multiple methods have the same name within the same class
A class inherits constructors from the base class
A method is declared without an implementation
items.explanation: The PDF defines override as when a derived class defines a method with the same name, same number and types of parameters, and same return type as a method in the base class.

items.question: In a constructor definition, the first action is often a call to _____.
items.explanation: The PDF states that super is the first action in a constructor definition.

items.question: Polymorphism allows a base class reference to refer to a derived class object.
items.explanation: The PDF states that polymorphism allows a base class reference to be used to refer to a derived class object.

items.question: What mechanism allows many meanings to be associated to one method name and binds the method definition at run time?
items.explanation: The PDF defines dynamic binding as allowing many meanings to be associated to one method name and not binding the definition until run time.

items.question: What is an abstract method?
options: A method declared as abstract and does not have an implementation, written without braces followed by a semicolon
A method that returns no value
A method that can be invoked without an object
A method that changes private instance variables
items.explanation: The PDF defines an abstract method as declared abstract and not having an implementation, written without braces followed by a semicolon.

items.question: An abstract class is a base for _____.
items.explanation: The PDF states that an abstract class is a base for subclasses.

items.question: An interface contains the heading for a number of public methods.
items.explanation: The PDF defines an interface as a program component that contains the heading for a number of public methods.

items.question: What keyword is used by a class to implement an interface?
items.explanation: The PDF lists interface and states implements.

items.question: What is a package?
options: A collection of related classes and interfaces
A collection of related objects only
A method that returns no value
A variable shared by all objects
items.explanation: The PDF defines a package as a collection of related classes and interfaces.

items.question: The name of the folder equals the name of the _____.
items.explanation: The PDF states that the name of the folder equals the name of the package.

items.question: A void method is used to return a value.
items.explanation: The PDF states that void means a method is not used to return a value.

items.question: What term refers to the object's name receiving the method call?
items.explanation: The PDF defines this as the object's name receiving the method call.

items.question: What does a private instance variable mean?
options: Its name cannot be used to access it outside a class
It has no restriction where you can use its name
It can be invoked anywhere without restriction
It is shared by all objects of its class
items.explanation: The PDF states that a private instance variable's name cannot be used to access it outside a class.

items.question: A public method can be invoked _____ without restriction.
items.explanation: The PDF states that a public method can be invoked anywhere without restriction.

items.question: Encapsulation hides implementation details.
items.explanation: The PDF states that encapsulation groups instance variables and methods into a class and hides implementation details.

items.question: What is the address of an object's memory location called?
items.explanation: The PDF defines a reference as the address of the object's memory location.

items.question: Which predefined Math class method is used for rounding?
options: Math.round()
Math.ceil()
Math.floor()
Math.random()
items.explanation: The PDF lists rounding as Math.round().

items.question: Math.pow() is used for _____.
items.explanation: The PDF lists power as Math.pow().

items.question: Static variables are constants.
items.explanation: The PDF states that static variables are not constants.

items.question: What term describes multiple methods having the same name within the same class?
items.explanation: The PDF defines overloading as when multiple methods have the same name within the same class.

items.question: What is inheritance?
options: The use of an existing class to define a new class
Combining data and actions into a single item
Restricting access to components
Invoking a method without using any object
items.explanation: The PDF defines inheritance as the use of an existing class to define a new class.

items.question: A derived class adds instance variables and methods to an existing class, which is called the _____ class.
items.explanation: The PDF defines a base class as the existing class that the derived class is built upon.

items.question: The super keyword must be the first action in a constructor definition.
items.explanation: The PDF states that super is the first action in a constructor definition.

items.question: What is the ability of an object to take on many forms?
items.explanation: The PDF defines polymorphism as the ability of an object to take on many forms.

items.question: Which statement about a constructor is correct?
options: It creates and initializes an object and uses the new keyword
It must have a return type
It cannot call methods within its class
It is inherited by every subclass
items.explanation: The PDF states that a constructor creates and initializes an object, uses the new keyword, does not have a return type, and can call methods within its class.

items.question: What type of method is declared as abstract and does not have an implementation?
items.explanation: The PDF defines an abstract method as declared abstract and not having an implementation.
